decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the crossover is used.
Condition : 4 - The width of the crossover hereby approved shall not exceed 2.4m

Condition : 5 - A gate of wrought iron or other similar open construction and a timber post not exceeding shall be provided to the southern end of the frontage at the entrance to the       existing path.

Condition : 6 - The wooden fence along the northern boundary of the site shall be reduced in height to     
 600mm maximum for a distance of at least 2.4 metres from the back of the footway before the access is brought into use and shall be permanently retained as such.

Condition : 7 - Either side of the vehicle access hereby approved, visibility splay areas measuring 2.4 metres deep from the back line of the footway and 2.4 metres wide shall be provided, as far as is possible on land within the applicant's ownership, before the access and parking area is brought into use. These areas shall be kept clear of any obstructions to visibility greater than 600 mm in height, including shrubs, planting, boundary walls, 		fences, gates, other means of enclosure or other structures or objects at all times.
